homepage.headline: Your Sacred Journey
homepage.description: Plan your Hajj or Umrah with a Lahore team that helps you choose flights, hotels and travel arrangements around your needs.

faqs.question: Which Umrah packages depart from Lahore?
faqs.answer: Haram Pak offers 15-day and 20-day Umrah itineraries with direct flights planned from Lahore. Ask our team to confirm dates, airline, fares and seat availability for your group.

faqs.question: What is included in an Umrah package?
faqs.answer: A quote can cover return flights, accommodation, visa assistance and ground transfers. Ask for a written breakdown of what is included in your itinerary before confirming.

faqs.question: Where do pilgrims stay in Makkah and Madinah?
faqs.answer: The 15-day and 20-day itineraries list Al Kiswah Towers in Makkah and Najoom Al Khair in Madinah, approximately 600 m from Masjid an-Nabawi. Hotels and walking routes should be confirmed for your travel dates.

faqs.question: Can you help with visas and travel documents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your itinerary and traveller details with our team so we can explain the current document checklist and visa process for your circumstances.

faqs.question: Can I tailor a package for my family?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us your preferred dates, group size, room requirements and any mobility needs so we can discuss suitable hotels, flights and transfers.

faqs.question: How do I get a price and confirm a booking?
faqs.answer: Request a quote with your travel month and group size. Our team can confirm availability and share the itinerary, total price and booking terms before you decide.
